$comment: Real-time (GTFS-RT) service settings; see PLAN.md §4.6. Upstream request rate is fixed by these intervals no matter how many clients connect.
$staleAfterS: Clients treat live data older than this as unavailable and fall back to schedule estimates.
$coverageGapS: Recorder coverage breaks when consecutive snapshots are further apart than this.
$maxInterpolateS: Interpolate a vehicle between two observations only when they are at most this far apart.
$maxExtrapolateS: At the live edge, dead-reckon a vehicle forward along its route for at most this long.
